## Decision

Fold journal-store-split into obsidian-native-groundwork. obsidian-native-groundwork owns the format cutover and bin/journal retirement; the reconciliation contract belongs in ticket 13. The standalone charter is retired after transplant.

## Rationale

The standalone charter was a one-session diagnosis artifact with six unratified proposed decisions. Leaving it alongside obsidian-native-groundwork would create exactly the duplicate-ownership divergence the fold exists to prevent. Ticket 13 was an empty template; it is now filled with the reconciliation contract.

## Alternatives Considered

- Keep journal-store-split as a separate motive — rejected, creates duplicate ownership and leaves ticket 13 empty
- Keep journal-store-split for integrity half only and transplant reconciliation contract — original recommendation, superseded by user decision to fold entirely
